dogecoin.text:
Today #Ethereum average transaction fee has reached the worst record - $60.

According to The Block,  hype around the Shiba Inu (SHIB) #token, a #Dogecoin clone, has contributed to this. https://t.co/oFG4ffh2Mg

Great news! Sheetz, an American chain of convenience stores and coffee shops, has started accepting #crypto payments.

The company will allow customers to pay with #bitcoin, #ether, litecoin, and dogecoin. https://t.co/eON3wHyDd4
